task.description: WF-02 step 5b gate, TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR over every new and changed test of M2.2: each of the 32 criteria has the tests the design names and they assert behaviour and state (not only that code runs); the oracles are independent of the code under test; no test weakened, skipped or deleted; the replacement edits of section 11 are exactly «was → became» and keep each prohibition; the step-06 fixes weaken nothing. Run a sample of the tests' logic YOURSELF with your own harness on fresh clones of the tag and 5f229ba under <scratch> (not node --test: decision 0110), apply at least 10 mutants of the design yourself in a temporary copy (hash the tree before and after; leave none), and read the GitHub run of ci/m2auth-4 (all jobs; pg 21 of 21; VB-1 ok). PASS or FAIL with findings. Be economical but complete. RULES OF THIS PC (decisions/0110, 0127, 0129): do NOT run npm run check, cd app && npm run ..., node --test, the tools test scripts or the e2e tests; the record of a test run is read from GitHub with gh run view (read-only). Node 22 first on PATH (<node22>). A server you start binds port 0 or a free high port and is stopped by its exact process id; never bind, probe or stop the ports 4780, 4781, 4782 and 4790. One browser at a time on this PC. No git commit, push, pull, checkout, stash, reset or tag. LF line endings. Never write the name of the reference product, nor a path of this computer, into a Sai file or a handoff (write <scratch> or <outside the project>). Fill only the result of your handoff; the top-level status stays PENDING and completed_at null: ORCH closes. English.

findings.place: app/test/int/auth-lockout.test.js LO-1, LO-3, LO-6 (and the lock answer of LO-5) against app/server/auth/lockout.js secondsLeft
findings.text: Own mutant O3 (Math.ceil → Math.floor in secondsLeft) survives: the design (4.9.5: Retry-After = ceil(seconds left)) and REQ-114 c5 («Retry-After equal to the seconds left») fix the rounding, but every probe of the lock and of the admin delay sits on a whole second, where ceil and floor agree. The rate-limit rounding is covered (O10 killed by RL-4).
findings.fix: TEST-DESIGNER adds one probe at a fractional offset, e.g. 1.5 s before the end of the admin delay and of an ordinary lock, expecting Retry-After «2». Not blocking.
